infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Meridian needs your location to show nearby safety alerts and calculate safe routes.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Meridian needs your location to send emergency alerts and track your safety even when the app is in the background.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Meridian needs camera access to let you capture and report crime incidents.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Meridian needs microphone access for voice commands and emergency SOS features.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Meridian needs photo library access to attach images to crime reports.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Meridian to use your location for safety alerts and emergency features.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Allow Meridian to track your location in the background for continuous safety monitoring.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow Meridian to access your location while using the app.

plugins.microphonePermission: Meridian listens for your SOS phrase only while you arm it, and only on this device.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Meridian recognises your SOS phrase on this device. No audio is sent anywhere.
